headline: Company Update

highlights: Agriculture accounts for ~59% of volumes with OTR share at ~37% Q 2FY2 7 Results: BKT reported mixed performance.
Standalone net sales for Q2’27 stood at ~ ₹3,490 crore, up 46% YoY amid tyre sales volume of 91,397 tonne, up 30% YoY.
EBITDA margins came in at 18%, down ~300 bps QoQ, courtesy higher RM and logistics cost.

Investment Rationale: • Strong Core OHT Franchise with Multiple Geographic Led Growth Drivers : BKT operates in a niche off highway tyre (OHT) segment which finds application in agriculture and mining/industrial purposes.
